scope: Additive evidence overlay; 15 active v16 passport identities, 15 historical records, existing Lean provenance and recent-results registry are unchanged. No new mathematical theorem is certified by this metadata edit.

policy.source_byte_check: Compare repository .lean file git blob SHA-1 to recorded content; no network lookup and no compilation.
policy.receipt_check: Run URLs and exact PR-head SHA are recorded historical references; CI success was inspected for #970/#976/#977/#978. The metadata checker does not verify GitHub's run logs or execute Lean.
policy.promotion_rule: No automatic status upgrade from references, metadata tests, imported hypotheses, or proof-term count. Require source+theorem+assumptions+transitive pins+named kernel replay+axiom and statement review+independent referee+dated prior art+owner release authorization.
policy.dependency_rule: Cycle is an error. Failure/withdrawal of any premise demotes dependent mathematical promotion until rebuilt, without erasing historical source receipts.
policy.external_source_rule: External reference, submitted source, site-local build, third-party kernel replay, independent semantic audit, and novel theorem are separate gates. Links do not imply complete verification.
policy.frozen_collections: Do not rewrite earlier claim IDs, release fingerprints or source-custody history.
